item.title: Data Shows Gulf Between 'MAGA,' 'MAHA,' and 'America First' Voters Over Iran, But Most Agree Israel Has 'Too Much Influence.'
item.description: Polling by the Democracy Institute has revealed where the divisions are among likely Republican voters regarding the ongoing U.S.-Israeli war on Iran. Among self-identified "MAGA" Republicans, President Trump's intervention in Iran is more popular than not, with 54 percent viewing the conflict as a "security necessity," while 43 percent see it as a "costly mistake."
